title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.77
summary: Gemeinsame Kiosk-Raster fuer Web und Linux-Client sowie Bewegungserkennung ohne Netzwerkspeicher-Startblockade.
changes: Store shared kiosk layouts and active view in server SQLite for web and Linux desktop
Prevent stale-client overwrites with atomic revisions and legacy local-layout migration
Start automatic motion detection and recording scheduler before network storage reconciliation
Preserve existing recording files, camera settings, and all existing streams
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.77
description: Server-authoritative cross-client kiosk layouts with safe migration plus recording startup sequencing.
releaseNotes: 2.20.77 centralizes Kiosk layout selection in server SQLite and synchronizes it across browser and Electron every five seconds. Existing local layouts are migrated once if no shared settings exist, with optimistic conflict protection. Motion detection and recording scheduling now start after local recovery but before possibly slow SMB/SFTP media reconciliation; archive cleanup remains last. Existing recordings are preserved.
